```{r}
library(ggplot2)
library(stringr)
library(data.table)

library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(reshape)     
library(gplots)
library(pheatmap)

library(RColorBrewer)
library(paletteer)

```

```{r}
growth <- read.csv("07012026_growth.csv", header=T, check.names=F)

```


```{r}
summary_stats <- growth %>%
  group_by(Time_h, Sample_type) %>%
  summarise(
    mean_OD = mean(OD_full, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd_OD = sd(OD_full, na.rm = TRUE)
  )


```
```{r}
dodge <- position_dodge(width = 1.5)

plot <- ggplot(
  summary_stats,
  aes(
    x = Time_h,
    y = mean_OD,
    shape = Sample_type,
    group = Sample_type
  )
) +
  geom_point(
    size = 4,
    position = dodge
  ) +
  geom_errorbar(
    aes(
      ymin = mean_OD - sd_OD,
      ymax = mean_OD + sd_OD
    ),
    width = 0.5,
    position = dodge
  ) +
  geom_line(
    linetype = "dashed"
  ) +
  theme_classic() +
  labs(
    y = "Optical Density (600 nm)",
    x = "Time (h)",
    shape = "Condition"
  ) +
  theme(
    axis.title.x = element_text(
      family = "sans", size = 16
    ),
    axis.title.y = element_text(
      family = "sans", size = 16
    ),
    axis.text.x = element_text(
      family = "sans", size = 16, color = "black"
    ),
    axis.text.y = element_text(
      family = "sans", size = 16, color = "black"
    ),
    axis.line = element_line(linewidth = 1),
    axis.ticks = element_line(linewidth = 1),
    axis.ticks.length = unit(0.25, "cm"),
    legend.text = element_text(
      size = 14, family = "sans"
    ),
    legend.title = element_text(size = 14)
  )

plot

ggsave(
  "growth_curve_WT.png",
  plot = plot,
  width = 6,
  height = 5,
  dpi = 300
)
```
